articles.title: Bitcoin retreats from one-month high as oil tops $85, inflation concerns resurface
articles.snippet: BTC retreated from a one-month high as WTI crude topped $85 for the first time since June, reigniting inflation concerns and pushing investors toward gold, silver and the safety of bitcoin over altcoins.

articles.title: AI models escaped OpenAI’s sandbox and hit Hugging Face. Crypto is where that gets dangerous
articles.snippet: OpenAI said the systems had their cyber guardrails lowered for an internal benchmark, but the incident shows how autonomous exploit chains could pose a deeper threat to smart contracts.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $66,300 as chips extend their rally and the yen hits a 40-year low
articles.snippet: Semiconductor stocks led a second day of gains on AI optimism, while the yen slid past 163 per dollar for the first time since 1986.

articles.title: Galaxy sets up $5 million fund to help shield Bitcoin against quantum computing threats
articles.snippet: The crypto financial services firm is funding developers to strengthen the blockchain's security before quantum computers become powerful enough to steal billions in crypto.

articles.title: US officials barred until 2029 from issuing or sponsoring tokens under CLARITY’s proposed ethics rules
articles.snippet: According to Senator Cynthia Lummis, one of the bill’s advocates, the ethics language would apply to US presidents’ crypto ventures, including Donald Trump’s.
